title: Boundary-Local Soft Supervision for Reliable Calibration in Defect Segmentation
mechanism: Boundary-gated label smoothing: local-mean soft targets only inside a morphological boundary band, hard BCE + Dice elsewhere.
adaptation: 2 px band around crack and inactive labels gets local-mean soft targets; main use is calibrated crack probabilities for decoding, ensembling and severity, not raw IoU.
min_experiment: Arm: house loss + BLSS band term, 5 seeds; baseline SUP100. Kill: 2 px band crack ECE on val not down 20%, or crack IoU drop > 0.012.
evidence: R: 4 defect datasets incl. DeepCrack, 20 seeds: boundary-band ECE down 28-49%, no Dice or Boundary-Dice degradation; weaker on Magnetic Tile.
